Costume: Seeking the Pearl (Standard Racing Racewear) Display
Hup!!

That's why it hit me. When I realized you prepared that food truck
and helped the master regain his confidence.

Oh, we're not done yet!
If we just keep pushing forward, we can transcend the entire world!

Seeking the Pearl presents!
A world carnival of love and hope... Sta-a-art!!

A globally beloved rocket firework show!
With blessings galore, this whole year is in the bag♪

With that message, I understood the purpose of the festival.
However—

My, look at you, Trainer! You're completely fired up!!
We have to cool you down♪

I make mistakes sometimes, like just now, right?
And whenever that happens... you're always there to back me up.

Led along by Seeking the Pearl,
I try matching her steps without even knowing what's happening...!
Fireworks shot up into the sky, spelling out giant letters—

Now then, it's free time from here on out!
Let's enjoy the festival!
Phew! That was a magnificent workout~!
Seeking the Pearl just jumped down out of nowhere?!

Even so, I really didn't want to make a mistake.
Heheh, I'll definitely have to get my revenge someday.
“SKNAHT”

What's up, Trainer!!
Say ho-o-o-o!!

Running across world-class races, on and on and on...
Reaching the very pinnacle of them all isn't just a dream!

Summer training camp arrived. Seeking the Pearl
was breezing through her training regimen in top form.
Just what I wanted! Let's keep marching forward to the ends of the earth!

But what I want to deliver to you is an even greater brilliance.
One so dazzling you can't help reaching out for it—

No! It's an even more world-class festival!
Here, this is your invitation. Check it and come on!!

Because you are right by my side!
We can make our infinite potential a reality!!
—A blazing jewel.

Bravo! "Just keep moving forward", you say?!
Could there ever be a better plan than that!
Heheh, you don't even realize it yourself, do you?

Seeking the Pearl reflects on how she only ever looks straight ahead.
However... there is no need for that.

Ohohohoho!
Welcome, Trainer!

How's that?
...Wait, nooo?! It's completely backward!!
Trainer... you really are something else...!

From here on, let's shine even brighter together.
Brighter than anyone else in the entire world...

Delivering passion straight from the land of the sun!
Come on, groove to the music with me!

I want Seeking the Pearl to charge full speed ahead toward the world.
Driven by passion, staying true to her convictions. That's why—
Heheh, your words are my greatest energy.

The main course starts now!
Come, let's head to the uninhabited island!

An Asian summer festival to blow away the heat!
Let's shooooot!!

...I always end up charging ahead all on my own.
And you're always there backing me up... aren't you, Trainer?
(Whizzz, whizzz, whizzz!!)

Rocket fireworks streaking across the twilight sky.
I can only stand there in utter awe.

The future ahead of us surely holds things beyond imagination.
Yet no matter what happens, I will always be right beside her... of that, I am certain.
Now, behold the continuation of our dream! Rocket maaaagic!

Seeking the Pearl gives a signal.
A sharp whistle shrills through the air—

Today's festival was my way of saying thank you.
...Even if it didn't quite go perfectly.

For instance, a course on the lunar surface! Racing against Space Umamusume!
Fufufu, the dream just keeps expanding!
...Right, Trainer?

Now, it's time for the finale.
Accept all my feelings—
—Jewel-like fireworks painted the night sky in brilliant hues.

It was the same when I tried to help out that bento shop.
All I could think about was spreading the word about their bento to as many people as possible.
Fufufu, the stars are beginning to come out. How beautiful...

I arrived at the coastline written on the invitation.
There shouldn't be any summer festivals scheduled around here, but—
